citations.text: Witvliet, Daniel, et al. (2020). Connectomes across development reveal principles of brain maturation. Nature.

description: Directed unweighted multigraph of all synaptic connections (chemical + electrical) in the L1 larval C. elegans. Each synapse is a separate edge. Contains self-loops (autapses via electrical junctions). No connection-type distinction (homogeneous).
name: C. elegans L1 Connectome Full (Witvliet 2020, Specimen 1, Unweighted)

recipe.reason: the graph joins the specimen's chemical synapse file with its gap junction file (Dataset1_gapjunctions.json beside it), and a recipe reads one download
